feeds.title: Women of Teal
feeds.description: Women of Teal is a play on the words 'Man of Steel' used to describe Superman. I have found my fellow ovarian cancer survivors to be the strongest, most helpful women in the world. They are truly Women of Teal!

feeds.title: The Teal Diaries
feeds.description: The Teal Diaries is Jacqueline Chartier's blog, offering readers a deeply personal exploration of her ongoing cancer journey. Her battle with the disease began in late 2011 when she was diagnosed with both uterine and ovarian cancer.

feeds.title: Oncology News Australia » Ovarian Cancer
feeds.description: With only incremental improvements in ovarian cancer survival over the last 40 years, there is a clear need for new treatment options with long-lasting results and Oncology News Australia gives all the news about it.

feeds.title: Ovarian Cancer News Today
feeds.description: The Web's Daily Resource for ovarian cancer news. Ovarian Cancer News Today is strictly a news and information website about the disease.

feeds.title: Global News » Ovarian Cancer
feeds.description: GlobalNews.ca is your source for the latest news and videos on Ovarian Cancer.

feeds.title: Hope for Barbara
feeds.description: Hope For Barbara is a blog about ovarian cancer and the long journey of diagnosis, chemo, side effects, insurance, drugs, and a big dose of hope! Barbara was diagnosed with Ovarian Cancer in March of 2009. In this blog, her daughter Holly provides education & awareness of ovarian cancer symptoms.

feeds.title: Talcum Powder Ovarian Cancer Center
feeds.description: Talcum Powder Ovarian Cancer Center reminds consumer that a talcum powder cancer lawsuit could be an option for women who used baby powder products and developed ovarian cancer.

feeds.title: Nobody Has Ovarian Cancer
feeds.description: Servivorgirl is my name. A woman abruptly redirected to a higher calling as a result of Stage IIIC ovarian cancer. Grow with me and read my blog posts to know my thoughts, essential information, helpful guidance, and tips.

feeds.title: Ovarian Cancer Research Alliance
feeds.description: Ovarian Cancer Research Alliance (OCRA) is the largest global nonprofit advancing ovarian cancer research while supporting women and their families. By following, you can stay informed with the latest updates about research, news, and action alerts.

feeds.title: Ovarian Cancer Research Alliance
feeds.description: The Clearity Foundation exists to help women find credible information about their ovarian cancer and the treatments that can help them survive. Our goal is to understand each patient's unique priorities and needs. Ovarian Cancer research is ongoing, so we are keeping close tabs on advances in the field. Follow these updates on the Clearity Blog.

feeds.title: Minnesota Ovarian Cancer Alliance
feeds.description: Formed in 1999 by a group of ovarian cancer survivors, MOCA is a statewide non-profit that serves women and families from throughout the Upper Midwest. The Minnesota Ovarian Cancer Alliance funds research, provides support to women and families, educates the medical community and raises awareness.

feeds.title: Huff Post » Ovarian Cancer
feeds.description: The destination for news, blogs and original content offering coverage of ovarian cancer.

feeds.title: Chatelaine » Ovarian Cancer
feeds.description: Our ovarian cancer blogger shares some disappointing news. Get the best recipes, easy meal plans, diet and nutrition tips, women's health advice, and fitness & exercise routines at Chatelaine.com!
